text:
Samira (Partnerships): FYI CloudVendor announced marketplace rate unit change next month. they want a joint cutover announcement + clear mapping from our usage units to their SKU before we flip. can we draft runbook?
Noah (Marketplace): theygave partners 30 days notice. main ask: how do we translate our 'token-second' metering into their 'token-minute' SKU without surprise rounding.
Rohit (Eng-Platform): technical: we currently emit usage in token-seconds per customer per minute buckets. we can produce a per-invoice conversion table: token_minutes = ceil(token_seconds / 60). but that leads to small upwards rounding.
Dana (Billing): rounding up will inflate partner bills. alternative: accumulate token_seconds across invoice period then round once at period end: token_minutes = ceil(sum(token_seconds)/60). preference: single-period rounding.
Yuki (Legal): need to confirm contract language for rounding and effective date. marketplace may require invoice-level line items that match their SKU. Also check limitation of liability for rounding delta.
Samira (Partnerships): proposal: 1) default: invoice-period rounding (safe), 2) offer optional per-minute alignment for partners that want strict parity (may cost extra compute/streaming), 3) publish mapping doc and FAQ in partner portal.
Noah (Marketplace): marketplace wants a sample CSV with columns: partner_id, customer_id, invoice_period_start, invoice_period_end, token_seconds, token_minutes_mapped, rounding_method. they will run their own reconcile.
Rohit (Eng-Platform): we can export that. example curl to request mapping export (partner-scoped):
```
GET /partners/{partner_id}/exports/usage-mapping?start=2026-04-01T00:00Z&end=2026-04-30T23:59:59
Authorization: Bearer <partner-key>
```
response -> CSV url with signed URL.
Dana (Billing): we also need a dispute workflow: partners can file a mapping dispute within 60 days of invoice. disputes under $150 per account auto-apply smoothing credit to next invoice; over that require manifest replay.
Rohit (Eng-Platform): manifest replay will include raw token_seconds events plus provenance; we'll tag each export row with event_count and raw_checksum so Marketplace can verify.
Yuki (Legal): also need a commercial opt-in: partners can choose either "marketplace-mode" (we emit mapped minutes matching their SKU) or "native-mode" (we emit raw seconds and they convert). add this as onboarding checkbox.
Samira (Partnerships): messaging: announce window and include migration checklist: sign opt-in by X date if you want marketplace-mode, else we'll default to native-mode + invoice-period rounding.
Noah (Marketplace): their tech ops asked about timezone boundaries: marketplace invoices are per-partner local TZ, while we bucket in UTC. How to avoid off-by-day issues?
Rohit (Eng-Platform): solution: for partners that request marketplace-mode, we will align bucketing to partner timezone for the invoice period only (compute cost applies). default remains UTC. we'll expose timezone param on export and manifest generation.
Dana (Billing): note for finance: when timezone-aligned exports are requested, we must tag the invoice lines with timezone metadata and keep reconciliation artifacts for 90 days.
Samira (Partnerships): what about late-arrival events? if token_seconds arrive after invoice close they can change minute counts. policy?
Dana (Billing): propose: invoice close window = 72 hours. events arriving within 72h post-close can be included as adjustments at discretion; beyond 72h must follow formal replay+claim with evidence. smoothing still applies for micro amounts.
Noah (Marketplace): marketplace wants a signed 'cutover_manifest' on cutover day listing mapping decisions per partner and sample lines for first invoice. that helps their billing ops.
Rohit (Eng-Platform): we can generate cutover_manifest with fields: partner_id, mode(numeric), timezone, rounding_method, example_lines and a signature. sample manifest creation call:
```
POST /internal/cutover-manifests
{ "partner_id": "cloudvendor", "start": "2026-05-01T00:00Z", "mode": "marketplace-mode", "timezone": "America/Los_Angeles" }
// returns manifest_url
```
(we'll return signed URL to CSV and JSON manifest).
Yuki (Legal): include a statement in manifest: "This manifest documents technical mapping for billing reconciliation and does not alter contractual pricing beyond the signed partner agreement."
Samira (Partnerships): timeline & action items: Rohit produce export & manifest APIs + sample CSV, Dana update dispute policy & smoothing thresholds, Yuki add cutover manifest clause, Partnerships prepare partner-facing announcement and migration checklist. deadline: publish draft in 5 business days.
ops-bot: "task created: #API-7012 (usage-mapping-export), #DOC-911 (cutover-manifest-template), #POL-430 (mapping-dispute-policy), #ANN-88 (marketplace-cutover-announcement)"
Dana (Billing): quick question: do we annotate each CSV row with conversion_method = (period_round, per_minute, partner_optin) so downstream systems know what happened?
Rohit (Eng-Platform): yes we'll add conversion_method + raw_seconds + mapped_minutes + checksum. also include original_bucket_start_ts so timezone alignment is verifiable.
Noah (Marketplace): sounds good. one more ask: provide a sandbox sample for marketplace to ingest a week's worth of mapped CSVs before live.
Samira (Partnerships): will coordinate staging access. Noah loop Marketplace Ops and we'll include sandbox steps in the checklist.
Rohit (Eng-Platform): implementation note: flag exports with retention=90d for cutover manifests. default export retention remains 7d.
Yuki (Legal): I'll draft the small addendum for partner agreements to capture mode selection and rounding rules.
Samira (Partnerships): thanks team. I'll draft announcement copy and share in #partnerships for review tomorrow morning.
ops-bot: "thread closed: marketplace-cutover-runbook-draft-started"
